facts.fact: Law 027-2024/ALT of 11 October 2024 provides for a national register of the unique identifier of natural persons, centralising their biographic and biometric data, with the body in charge to be created by decree and enrolment to follow the system's set-up.
facts.system: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique

facts.fact: Law 027-2024/ALT says the national register of the unique identifier is the reference base for identifying a person when issuing administrative titles and documents, and public services may require authentication against it.
facts.system: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique

systems.system: registre national de l'identifiant unique de la personne physique
systems.owner: organisme en charge de l'identifiant unique (to be created by decree)
